card.name: Emergency readiness and epinephrine dose amounts
card.fires_on: Two settings: the word before emergency resuscitation gear or drugs ("Always have", "access to", "setting where"), and the empty spot just before an epinephrine or naloxone dose number.

modes.label: Have emergency equipment ready
modes.description: Verb or linking word just before resuscitation personnel, equipment or rescue medications are named.

modes.label: Before a rescue dose amount
modes.description: The spot right before a rescue-drug dose number such as 0.3-0.5 mg.
